CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `m_tindakan2026` (
  `id` int(10) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `idperkiraan` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `kode` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `kodegdg` int(6) NOT NULL,
  `kategori` varchar(25) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `nama` varchar(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `mesin` varchar(15) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'untuk ormasbia mesin dipakai simpan kode tindakan',
  `cetak` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `hargarj` double(22,0) NOT NULL,

  `disckyw` double(22,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

  `frawat` varchar(1) NOT NULL,

  `class` varchar(15) NOT NULL,
  `pav` varchar(7) NOT NULL,
  `fubah` varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  `bukutarif` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `rakigd` varchar(3) NOT NULL,
  `kodeaskesrj` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `kodeaskesri` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `bab` int(5) NOT NULL,
  `subbab` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `subbab2` int(11) NOT NULL,

  `nobuku` int(11) NOT NULL,

  `kodeinhealthrj` varchar(16) NOT NULL,

  `accubah` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `alasan` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `idgo` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hrdokter1` double(22,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'untuk dokter gigi',
  `prperujuk` double(22,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `hargalab` double(22,0) NOT NULL,
  `bpjsnaker` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'presentase',
  `qtyecer` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `discpromo` double(22,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  `specimen` varchar(25) NOT NULL,
  `specimencode` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `specmethod` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `specmethodcode` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `loinc` varchar(15) NOT NULL,

  KEY `fkelompok` (`fkelompok`) USING BTREE,
